final: WITH c AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.product_color,'') AS color, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice_Line_Items l JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.product_color,'')), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, AVG(cnt*1.0) AS av FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt*1.0) AS avg_count, AVG(c.cnt*1.0/t.total) AS avg_share, AVG(c.cnt - t.av) AS avg_excess FROM c, t WHERE c.cnt > t.av
